This overview is in preparation. Times follow the autumn semester 2026; dates and rooms are still to be confirmed. KSL is the binding source.
:::

The autumn semester is where both programmes start: *Introduction to Digital Humanities*, the *DH Lab* and the lecture series form the **Introduction** block (13 ECTS) of the Major and the Minor (see [Studying DH in Bern](../index.qmd)). Major students in their 3rd semester take the **Application** block; Minor students in their 3rd semester complete their **final project**.

- **Lecture period:** 20 September – 24 December 2027
- **Registration:** via [KSL](https://www.ksl.unibe.ch/KSL/home); course material on [ILIAS](https://ilias.unibe.ch/)
- **Questions about the study programmes:** Adrian Demleitner, head of study programmes ([adrian.demleitner@unibe.ch](mailto:adrian.demleitner@unibe.ch))
